title: GBP/JPY Finds Three Reasons to Rebound as BoE and BoJ Risks Converge
summary: GBP/JPY enters a back-to-back central-bank week with three independent arguments for a rebound—the BoE’s hawkish bloc has little room to retreat, a fully priced BoJ hike may give Yen no new information, and the pair is oversold at a two-layer technical support zone—creating an asymmetric setup where the bullish threshold is lower than the bearish one. title: Canadian Dollar: CPI test for BoC inflation warning – BBH
summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes that Canada’s August Consumer Price Index (CPI) will test the Bank of Canada’s (BoC) warning that upside inflation risks have increased. Headline CPI is expected to remain at 3.0% y/y, while core measures are seen hovering around 2%.
